local_context.value: Auburndale (Wikipedia): humid subtropical zone; terrain 'flatland interspersed with gently rolling hills'; 2020 Census: 6,295 housing units, 9.1% vacant; Auburndale City Hall built 1927 (NRHP 2013). Lake setting: Lake Ariana Park (city parks page) on Lake Ariana; a developer page places the city between Lakes Juliana, Mattie, Arietta and Van (non-official). NWS Tampa Bay: West Central Florida rainy season May 25 to October 10, with frequent thunderstorms, lightning, damaging winds and heavy rainfall. No Auburndale-specific rainfall or housing-age figure found from an official source.
